text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: Let's get ready for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The best? We're aiming way higher than 
that, aren't we?!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Otherwise, I'll never overcome this wall!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Let's set our sights even higher! That's 
what you and I do, right?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you feel the same way? I knew you'd 
get it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing higher than first place, 
but there's always something beyond it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Far, far down the road, someday— we'll 
definitely reach our dream!
